connectors.sessions/authored/continuity-.purpose: F06: restart/loss does not create a replacement lease or synthesize a successful close.
Review B: actual owner/continuity loss during teardown becomes Lost while preserving the first terminal.

connectors.sessions/authored/direct-part.purpose: F06: partitioned direct path observes existing lease expiry, no extra grace or receipt-time reset.

connectors.sessions/authored/drain-expir.purpose: F06: a previously announced drain caps live authority; its deadline is already the last-data deadline.

connectors.sessions/authored/expired-dat.purpose: Review B: expiry observed during data admission atomically starts Closing; a later allow cannot renew.

connectors.sessions/authored/first-termi.purpose: F06: later revocation cannot create a second terminal; uncertain cleanup does not fabricate closed.

connectors.sessions/authored/late-renewa.purpose: F06: a delayed otherwise-authentic renewal cannot revive a locally expired terminal session.

connectors.sessions/authored/media-incom.purpose: E20: media_incompatible is admitted by the shared sessions terminal vocabulary.

connectors.sessions/authored/media-overl.purpose: E20: media_overload is admitted by the shared sessions terminal vocabulary.

connectors.sessions/authored/revocation-.purpose: F06: a trusted revoked decision atomically starts Closing, so a later observation cannot restart authority or deadlines.
F06: closing cuts off local data permission and renewal; peer silence cannot prevent local release.

connectors.sessions/authored/revoked-dur.purpose: F06: revocation before application/media readiness returns no ready session.

connectors.sessions/authored/unverified-.purpose: F06: an unknown deadline/trust bound prevents readiness and data admission.
